items.t: re: fantasy bigotry not intended to resemble real life bigotry so, what i was thinking about was my oc species the penodir. the penodir were created by a powerful pseudodeity (anything that is powerful enough to be mistaken for a deity, but has not undergone apotheosis). the pseudodeity manipulated and abused the penodir into hunting sapient beings under the belief they were just animals. any time a penodir got close to figuring out they were hunting sapient beings, the pseudodeity physically and mentally reset them to toddlerhood. eventually, the pseudodeity was killed and the truth of what they had been doing was revealed to the penodir. being sapient beings with free will and a social instinct, the vast, vast majority of penodir wanted to stop killing. the rest of the galactic grouping’s sophont species were not willing to give them a chance. the thing is; because there are no laws in space and “crime” makes up a massive portion of the space economy, penodir were able to be pigeonholed into murder jobs. even their descendants (penodir were gifted the ability to reproduce by a deity; if a penodir loves a small mechanical object long enough it has a chance to turn into a baby penodir) are often unable to find non-violent work because of esxtreme employment discrimination. and on top of that, in places where penodir and elgavans (a species near deified and given the benefit of the doubt by other sophonts) work and/or live together, elgavans are able to blame their wrongdoings on penodir to near universal success. in my mind, the penodir have always been victims. first of the pseudodeity, and now of other sophonts.
